title: Governance and expertise map
contextText: Expertise mapping for the Fenwick Retail deployment; notes only.

note.body:
# Governance and expertise map

**Date:** September 15
**Attendees:** Maren Mockwell, Dashiell Placeholder, Sienna Fixture, Gwen Placeholder

## Summary

Fenwick Retail is moving from a pilot to a full deployment of Zephyr Suite, and the working group met to record who knows what, so that questions from the stores reach the right person. The group also set up the Governance framework, the project that will write the internal rules for using the suite's forecasting features.

## Where the expertise sits

- Maren Mockwell is the group's expert on AI governance and has written two policies on the subject for previous employers.
- Dashiell Placeholder is a practitioner with Zephyr Suite: he configured the pilot stores and still answers their questions.
- Sienna Fixture is aware of Data residency requirements but said she is not an expert and would want legal review of anything binding.

## Adoption status

- Fenwick Retail has moved Zephyr Suite from a pilot to adopted across the northern region, so the earlier pilot status no longer applies.
- The Governance framework concerns AI governance and will be reviewed by the legal team before it is published.

## Roles in the Governance framework

- Maren Mockwell advises the Governance framework and does not own its delivery.
- Gwen Placeholder owns the budget for the Governance framework and said she is supportive of the approach.

## Observations

- Dashiell Placeholder asked many questions about the draft timeline, but said nothing about whether he agrees with the plan.
- The group agreed that the framework should stay short enough for store managers to read.

## Open points

The schedule for legal review is not set. Whether the framework will also cover the supplier forecasting data has not been decided.
